Reading memo_servicewebhooks.go and webhook.go to identify the dispatch functions.

Verifying call sites of the dispatch functions to confirm the lifecycle events.

Four lifecycle events dispatch webhooks from `memo_service_webhooks.go`:

- created → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.created`)
- updated → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.updated`)
- deleted → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memos.memo.deleted`)
- comment created → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.comment.created`)

All converge at `webhook.PostAsync`, which workers call as `webhook.Post`.

The actual HTTP delivery happens in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` as `webhook.Post`. `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` routes the three main lifecycle events through `webhook.PostAsync`, while `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly.
I'll confirm these dispatch functions are the only memo lifecycle webhook callers.
